mechanism: Both drugs cause CNS depression through different pathways (benzodiazepine GABA-A agonism and monoamine depletion), with additive sedative and motor effects; deutetrabenazine may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing diazepam levels.
action: Monitor for excessive sedation, dizziness, and motor impairment; consider dose reduction of diazepam or alternative anxiolytic if CNS depression becomes problematic.
